title: Reverse Array
description: Given an array of $n$ integers, print the array in reverse order.
inputFormat:
The first line contains an integer $n$ ($1 \leq n \leq 10^5$) — the size of the array.

The second line contains $n$ space-separated integers $a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_n$ ($-10^9 \leq a_i \leq 10^9$).
outputFormat: Print $n$ space-separated integers — the elements of the array in reverse order.
